about: USAJOBS (usajobs.gov), the U.S. federal government's job board. The CLI searches federal job announcements with filters, sorting and pagination, fetches job details, suggests keywords and locations, lists recruiting events, and saves jobs for signed-in users.

commands.summary: Get one job announcement's details (title, agency, salary, location, dates, description, duties, qualifications) by its numeric announcement id

params.name: id
params.description: Numeric job announcement id (DocumentID / number in the /job/ URL)

commands.summary: Get keyword or job-title suggestions for a partial search term
Get location name suggestions for a partial place name, to use as search-jobs --location
List federal recruiting events (career fairs, webinars, info sessions), optionally only online events
Get a recruiting event's details (date, time, venue, address, website, description, host) by event id
List the job announcements linked to a recruiting event
